sourceSurfaceMap.authority: This map gives only the relation between inventories and reader ownership. Execute the declared inventory checks for source freshness. All these checks must exit with code zero. The inventories give source API information to the map. The map is not a check of semantic completeness.
sourceSurfaceMap.unmappedScope: This map gives no coverage result for network exposure details outside the nine platform mapping groups. It gives none for environment/secret/derived-value occurrence ownership or deployed payload fields. It gives none for API/error/capability/contract families outside these adapters.

domains.readerTask: Select an SDK entrypoint. Use its consumer meaning. Obey all its field/codec rules. Use the bounded pure JSON example.
domains.scope: This scope includes all exports in the SDK package-export map, with export-star and named export overrides. It includes no other exports.

domains.readerTask: Before you change a public SDK callback or wrapper contract, find the source-qualified support declaration. Also find its members and referenced declaration.
domains.scope: This scope includes all KubeClaw support declarations that the compiler finds through the public SDK. It also includes their resolved members and qualified local reference edges. It includes no other declarations. These declarations are not named SDK exports.

domains.readerTask: Before you change or operate the selected item, find its source occurrence and activation boundary. Also find the platform explanation with authority for the selected item.
domains.scope: This scope includes only the nine platform inventory groups. Names can be the same in different sources. Source-qualified occurrences keep their source identities.

domains.readerTask: Before you change a CI path, find the workflow trigger, job, and command/action authority.
domains.scope: This scope includes all workflow and job records that the workflow inventory finds. It includes no other workflow or job records. It does not include workflow action internals outside these records.

domains.readerTask: Before you select a package guide or change the package contract, find the package manifest and registration identity.
domains.scope: This scope includes all manifest packages and registrations from the plugin-system inventory. It includes no other packages or registrations. It does not include all implementation files.

domains.readerTask: Before you change a configuration field, find its source document and nested field identity. Then read its receiver, precedence, and failure boundary.
domains.scope: This scope includes all document fields in the recursive configuration-values inventory. It includes no other document fields. It keeps each document index and field path.

domains.readerTask: Find the registered schema or compact swarm field. Read its declared validation/defaults and runtime consumer behavior. Do not use one as the other.
domains.scope: This scope includes registered schema fields and compact swarm fields in the inventory. It includes no other fields. Field identities keep paths and branch identities.
